message.content: {"note_claim": "Apollo spacecraft used onboard guidance computers and inertial navigation (no GPS needed).", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The AGC provided computation and electronic interfaces for guidance, navigation, and control of the spacecraft.", "reason": "The page directly states that an onboard computer (AGC) was installed on each command module and lunar module and handled guidance and navigation, and it lists the IMU as a connected port."}
